description.value: India Chaat House is an Indian restaurant situated on Marine Drive in White Rock, a scenic waterfront road that is a popular cycling route along Semiahmoo Bay. The restaurant is part of a two-location chain with a second outpost in Vancouver's Davie Street neighbourhood. Its location on Marine Drive puts it directly in the path of cyclists touring the South Surrey and White Rock waterfront.
